model: sklearn Ridge(alpha=100.0, positive=True) from HW4 model.fit_weights
role_in_hw4: comparison model of development.md, refit before each validation year
hw4_source: branch hw_4_Qianhao_Meng, commit 80640fc7, model.fit_weights and model.walk_forward_scores
reproduction_check: fit date, training rows and rounded weight shares match the audit values recorded in HW4 development.md. The HW4 source files are not verified against the commit by this script
target: gross adjusted-price return from the next session's close to the first quoted close on or after 90 calendar days, clipped to the training 1% and 99% quantiles
feature_rule: same-date percentile ranks among eligible stocks, higher is better, low volatility already reversed, missing component = 0.5
